steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Dance reflects the society in which it is created, responding to political, economic and social conditions

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Cultural traditions shape dance vocabulary, from Bharatanatyam's Hindu storytelling to Flamenco's Romani heritage

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Technology has expanded dance through lighting, projection, digital music and motion capture

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Gender roles in dance have evolved — from male-only court ballet to challenging stereotypes in contemporary work

steps.title: Try it yourself

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always link social or cultural factors to specific choreographic choices in the prescribed work When discussing gender, use examples from professional works rather than general statements Technology questions should focus on how it enhances or changes the audience's experience Use the phrase 'social and cultural context' directly — it is key AQA terminology Be prepared to discuss multiple influences on one work, not just a single factor
